title: English for Life and Work: Elementary

program.section_heading: English for Life and Work: Elementary
outcomes: Apply and use correct word order, grammar, and vocabulary encountered at the elementary level to construct original sentences in guided exercises.
Read and respond to short reading selections about everyday social and personal business comprehending expressions and vocabulary encountered in class using elementary-level academic reading skills.
Recite and improvise elementary-level dialogues demonstrating major social functions of language with increasing fluency and clear pronunciation.
Write elementary-level original sentences, short notes, and letters as well as familiar sentences accurately from dictation and complete forms and applications correctly.

notes: Noncredit Certificate of Competency (CDCP). The catalog counts it in units and prints 0.0 Units. It prints no hours, so measure is 'units' and totals are recorded as the printed 0.
The catalog prints the codes without a space ('ELW901', 'ELW902'). These match closed-list ELW 901 and ELW 902, so catalog_addition is false.
The required-courses block sits inside an outer 'English for Life and Work: Elementary (Total 0) Complete all of the following' wrapper. Only the inner block is recorded.

Award instructions say students must complete courses culminating in the successful completion of ELW 902. This suggests a progression rather than a strict requirement to take both courses; a reviewer may want to check it.

A stray lead-in ('Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:') appears after the description with no outcomes under it. The outcomes are recorded from the Program Learning Outcomes heading.
